title: Screens and network PCs
action.tryTip: Apply the screens for 15 s. Network PCs move when you save.
try.reverting: Reverting in %1 s unless you confirm.
side.mickeyMissing: Network PCs use Mickey, a free program that shares one keyboard and mouse between computers. It is not installed on this PC.
side.mickeyStopped: Mickey is installed but not running.
side.noPcs: No PC paired yet. Add one, then drag it next to your screens: the cursor crosses where they touch, and the keyboard follows.
peer.reinstalled: reinstalled: remove it and add it again
peer.edgeHint: Push the cursor across the shared edge and the keyboard goes with it. AltGr + Right Shift brings it back.
peer.noEdgeHint: It touches no screen, so the cursor cannot cross. Drag it against a screen, or use the hotkeys.
peer.hotkeysHint: Off the layout: reach it with AltGr + Right Shift, or with Send keyboard.
peer.sendKeyboardTip: Hold Right Shift for 3 s to bring the keyboard and mouse home at any time.
peer.removeAsk: Remove this PC? It stops being trusted and Mickey restarts.
add.title: Add a network PC
add.needsMickey: Start Mickey on this PC first.
add.searching: Looking for PCs running Mickey on this network (they announce every 3 s)...
add.found: Running Mickey on this network. Connect, then check that both screens show the same six-digit code.
add.name: Name
add.byAddressHint: For a PC on another network segment. On that PC, let a new PC pair first (Mickey settings, or the button below there).
add.overSsh: Over SSH, for a PC without a screen to compare codes on
add.overSshHint: Opens a terminal that installs Mickey there and pairs the two PCs through SSH instead of the code. For boards and kiosks you already reach by SSH (x86-64 and ARM64 Linux).
add.letPair: Let a PC pair with this one
add.letPairTip: For 2 minutes, a PC that adds this one by address may ask to pair.
status.hint: Drag or arrow keys to move (Shift: fine / no snapping) · Tab: next · Ctrl+Z: undo · Esc: close
status.applied: Applied. Save it to keep it after a restart.
status.savedAll: Saved. Every PC in the group learns the new layout.
status.savedNotRunning: Saved. Mickey is not running: the layout applies when it starts.
status.oneScreen: At least one screen must stay on.
status.mickeyUnreadable: Couldn't read Mickey's config.toml, nothing saved.
status.installing: Installing Mickey in a terminal. Reload when it is done.
status.badAddress: That is not an address like 192.168.0.10 or 192.168.0.10:4242.
status.badName: Give the PC a name (no quotes or backslashes).
status.badSsh: That is not an SSH destination like user@192.168.0.20.
status.pairingAsked: Check that this PC and %1 show the same code, then press Pair on both.
status.pairingOpen: For 2 minutes, another PC may ask to pair with this one.
status.sshStarted: Setting up %1 in a terminal. It shows up here when it is done.
bar.remote: Keyboard and mouse on %1. Hold Right Shift for 3 s to bring them home.
bar.off: Screens and network PCs (Mickey is not running)
